title: Thumbnail service
description: Rows are in triage order: start at the top and stop at the first layer that looks wrong.

panels.title: Reliability indicators over the selected time range
Thumbnail success · target 99%
panels.description: Share of synthetic uploads whose 100x100 thumbnail could be downloaded within 30 s.

panels.title: Thumbnail within 10 s · target 95%
panels.description: Share of synthetic uploads whose thumbnail was ready within 10 s. Agenda polls for jobs every 5 s, which sets the floor.

panels.title: Gateway availability · target 99.5%
panels.description: Share of requests on the public listener without a 5xx, including errors Envoy generates itself. 4xx are excluded: the app answers every error with a 400.

panels.title: API within 500 ms · target 95%
panels.description: Share of /thumbnail requests the API answered within 500 ms, measured in the app.

panels.title: Prober success ratio (5 m)
panels.description: Upload, wait for the worker, download, every 30 s through the gateway.

panels.title: Upload to thumbnail time
panels.description: Successful runs only. Mostly queue wait: Agenda polls every 5 s; resizing takes ~70 ms.

panels.title: Failed runs by stage
panels.description: Where it broke: upload (gateway/API), processing (worker/queue), download (storage).

panels.title: Requests by status class
panels.description: Everything clients saw. 5xx include no healthy backend (503) and timeouts (504).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_bucket{namespace="thumbnail", component="api", http_route=~"/thumbnail.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Failed writes to MinIO
panels.description: Uploads (API) and thumbnails (worker) that MinIO didn't store, from network errors or MinIO's own 4xx/5xx. The app hides these: the API returns 200 before storing the upload, and the worker marks jobs complete even if the thumbnail wasn't saved.

panels.title: Event loop delay p99
panels.description: How long the Node.js event loop is blocked. The worker's goes up while sharp resizes.

targets.expr: max by (container) (max by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace="thumbnail", container=~"api|worker|prober|mongodb|minio"}) / on (namespace, pod, container) max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace="thumbnail", resource="memory"}))

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: The API restarts when MongoDB is unreachable: it crashes on the first failed database call.

panels.title: MinIO free space
panels.description: Nothing is ever deleted, so this only goes down. On kind it reports the node's disk.

panels.title: Objects in the thumbnails bucket
panels.description: Originals plus thumbnails. MinIO refreshes this every few minutes.
